command:
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); logs=root/"logs/v0.1.2"
baseline=json.loads((logs/"input_hashes.json").read_text())
for name,expected in baseline.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,"受保护文件变化: "+name
print("PASS:",len(baseline),"个受保护文件字节未变（旧证明、合同、路线图、固定配置、日志脚本、旧日志和其他工程/全局设置）。")
assert (root/"PROGRESS.md").read_text().endswith((logs/"before_PROGRESS.md").read_text())
print("PASS: 上一阶段 PROGRESS 原文完整保留。")
formal=sorted(list(root.glob("*.lean"))+list((root/"LeanPML").rglob("*.lean")))
assert len(formal)==6
decls=[]
for f in formal:
 code=re.sub(r"/-[\s\S]*?-/","",f.read_text())
 code=re.sub(r"--[^\n]*","",code)
 assert not re.search(r"\b(sorry|admit|axiom|sorryAx)\b",code),str(f)
 ns=re.search(r"^namespace (\S+)",code,re.M)
 if ns:
  decls.extend(ns.group(1)+"."+name for name in re.findall(r"^theorem (\w+)",code,re.M))
 assert (root/".lake/build/lib/lean"/f.relative_to(root).with_suffix(".olean")).is_file()
audited=re.findall(r"^#print axioms (LeanPML\.\S+)",(root/"Audit.lean").read_text(),re.M)
assert len(decls)==32 and len(audited)==32 and set(decls)==set(audited)
assert sum(n.startswith("LeanPML.Debye.") for n in decls)==20
source=(root/"LeanPML/Debye/ScalarEnergy.lean").read_text()
assert len(re.findall(r"^noncomputable def ",source,re.M))==4
assert not (root/"LeanPML/PML/TimeInvariants.lean").exists()
print("PASS: 六个正式模块均有构建产物；Debye四定义/20定理；全项目32定理均有审计；无占位或提前实现v0.1.3。")
for stem in ["20261010T010100_916130_lake_build_retry","20261010T010129_718599_axioms_audit"]:
 m=json.loads((logs/(stem+".json")).read_text())
 assert m["exit_code"]==0 and m["status"]=="finished" and m["cwd"]==str(root)
 body=(logs/(stem+".log")).read_text()
 pairs=re.findall(r"'([^']+)' depends on axioms: \[([^\]]+)\]",body)
 assert len(pairs)==32 and {n for n,_ in pairs}==set(decls)
 for name,axioms in pairs:
  assert set(axioms.split(", "))=={"propext","Classical.choice","Quot.sound"},name
 assert "sorryAx" not in body
build=(logs/"20261010T010100_916130_lake_build_retry.log").read_text()
for mod in ["LeanPML.Debye.ScalarEnergy","LeanPML","Audit"]:
 assert "Built "+mod in build
assert json.loads((logs/"20261010T010036_323185_lake_build.json").read_text())["exit_code"]==1
print("PASS: 最终构建/独立审计真实退出0（包含全部8条实例定理）；首次失败完整保留。")
manifest=json.loads((root/"lake-manifest.json").read_text())
for dep in manifest["packages"]:
 repo=root/".lake/packages"/dep["name"]
 actual=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(repo),"rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
 assert actual==dep["rev"],dep["name"]
assert 'defaultTargets = ["LeanPML", "Audit"]' in (root/"lakefile.toml").read_text()
for mod in ["Tutorial.LocalEnergy","Tutorial.ScalarEnergy","Time.Monotonicity","Debye.ScalarEnergy"]:
 assert "import LeanPML."+mod in (root/"LeanPML.lean").read_text()
print("PASS:",len(manifest["packages"]),"个依赖实际提交与manifest一致；正式导入链覆盖全部证明。")
for name in ["README.md","PROGRESS.md"]:
 body=(root/name).read_text()
 for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",body):
  target=target.strip("<>")
  if target.startswith(("http:","https:","#")): continue
  target=re.sub(r":\d+$","",target.split("#",1)[0])
  file=Path(target) if target.startswith("/") else root/target
  assert file.exists(),name+": "+target
 assert len(re.findall(r"^\$\$$",body,re.M))%2==0
 assert len(re.findall(r"^\x60\x60\x60",body,re.M))%2==0
print("PASS: README/PROGRESS本地链接有效、显示数学与代码块成对。")
artifacts=formal+[root/n for n in ["README.md","lean-toolchain","lakefile.toml","lake-manifest.json","scripts/run_logged.py"]]
hashes={str(f.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in artifacts}
(logs/"verified_artifact_hashes.json").write_text(json.dumps(hashes,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print("已保存正式源码、README和固定配置/脚本的交付哈希；PROGRESS随后追加本检查链接，未冻结其字节。")
print("FINAL: v0.1.2 验收通过；本轮未进入v0.1.3。")
